name: Pulsora MCP - PreProd
description: Pulsora MCP Connector for accessing the Pulsora PreProd environment

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pulsora MCP - PreProd to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pulsora MCP - PreProd to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://preprod.pulsesg.net/be/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pulsora MCP - PreProd MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pulsora MCP - PreProd lists 27 MCP tools, including compare_metrics_across_periods, count_required_metrics, find_metric_group, get_org_context, list_catalog_topics, list_catalogs, list_metric_groups, list_periods, pulsora_get_competitor_feed, pulsora_get_competitor_intelligence, pulsora_get_competitor_trend, and pulsora_get_competitors.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pulsora MCP - PreProd?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Pulsora MCP - PreProd in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Pulsora MCP - PreProd MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pulsora MCP - PreProd requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pulsora MCP - PreProd is developed by Pulsora, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
